projectDescription: Ask Wire is a real estate data API providing property listings, foreclosures, geocoding, GIS layers, valuation tools, and neighbourhood intelligence for Greece and Cyprus.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive property listings and foreclosure data for Greece and Cyprus
Rich filtering by price, size, location, building attributes, and data quality flags
Geospatial search via radius, bounding box, polygon, and WKT geometry
Address geocoding with optional KAEK (cadastral parcel) lookup
GIS layer queries for parcels, crime data, flood zones, seismic zones, and wildfire risk
Reconstruction cost valuation (as-new and depreciated) by postal code and property type
Neighbourhood points of interest (POIs) with per-category search radii
Hierarchical geographic dictionary (regions, regional units, municipalities)
JWT-based authentication via a dedicated auth service
publicApiSurface: POST /auth/otp/login — Authenticate and receive a Bearer token
GET /api/properties/ — List and filter properties (listings & foreclosures)
GET /api/properties/{id}/ — Retrieve a single property by ID
GET /api/properties/ref-id/{reference_id}/ — Retrieve a property by reference ID
GET /api/geocoding/kaek-search/ — Look up a parcel by KAEK cadastral code
GET /api/gis/ — Query GIS layer properties (apaa, crime, parcel) for a coordinate
GET /api/layer-properties/ — Query environmental/geographic layers for a coordinate
POST /api/points-of-interest/ — List nearby points of interest for a coordinate
GET /api/municipalities/ — List municipalities in the geographic hierarchy
GET /api/regional-units/ — List regional units in the geographic hierarchy
